oracle.invariant: Every run exits 0 with 0 failures and 0 skipped tests. No popup opens on Create site: the form shows [data-questions-card] under the template card and the site address, above Create site, reading '4 questions' and 'Receive a site tailored to you.' (three single lines and no answers on the card since #1001) Pressing the card draws [data-questions-sheet="1"] on the bottom edge of the panel; the required Sector question is first with a Recommended tag; Done, the X, a click on [data-questions-scrim="1"] and Escape each close it, keep the answers and give focus back to the card. Changing template keeps the answers the new set still asks (same id, value still offered), drops the rest, and the sheet (not the card, since #1001) reads 'Answers kept for this design: 1. Answers that no longer apply: 1.'
